change_summary: The journal posted an expression of concern titled for this paper, saying the editors have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article. The matter is still being looked into, and readers will be updated later. The notice does not say which data are concerned, so the findings are in doubt but it is unclear which ones.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The stored paper reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test. The journal's expression of concern says the editors have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article, but the notice does not say which data. So it is unclear whether the change touches your use of the reduced-activity finding. Overall the impact on you is medium, with that uncertainty, since your Discussion and proposal lean on this finding.
